pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.2: atha kho devadatto yena kokāliko kaṭamodakatissaka khaṇḍadeviyā putto samuddadatto tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā kokālikaṃ kaṭamodakatissakaṃ khaṇḍadeviyā puttaṃ samuddadattaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.3: “etha mayaṃ āvuso samaṇassa gotamassa saṅghabhedaṃ karissāma cakkabhedanti.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.6: kathaṃ mayaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa saṅghabhedaṃ karissāma cakkabhedanti.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.7: etha mayaṃ āvuso samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pañca vatthūni yācissāma:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.8: “bhagavā bhante anekapariyāyena appicchassa santuṭṭhassa sallekhassa dhutassa pāsādikassa apacayassa vīriyārambhassa vaṇṇavādī”.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.9: imāni bhante pañca vatthūni anekapariyāyena appicchatāya santuṭṭhiyā sallekhāya dhutāya pāsādikāya apacayāya viriyārambhāya saṃvattanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.12: yo gāmantaṃ osareyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.14: yo nimantanaṃ sādiyeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.16: yo gahapaticīvaraṃ sādiyeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.18: yo channaṃ upagaccheyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.20: yo macchamaṃsaṃ khādeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.22: te mayaṃ imehi pañcahi vatthūhi janaṃ saññāpessāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.23: sakkā kho āvuso imehi pañcahi vatthūhi samaṇassa gotamassa saṅghabhedo kātuṃ cakkabhedo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.1: atha kho devadatto sapariso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho devadatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.3: “bhagavā bhante anekapariyāyena appicchassa santuṭṭhassa sallekhassa dhutassa pāsādikassa apacayassa
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.5: imāni bhante pañca vatthūni anekapariyāyena appicchatāya santuṭṭhiyā sallekhāya dhutāya pāsādikāya apacayāya
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.8: yo gāmantaṃ osareyya, vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya. yāvajīvaṃ piṇḍapātikā assu, yo nimantanaṃ sādiyeyya, vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya. yāvajīvaṃ paṃsukūlikā assu, yo gahapaticīvaraṃ sādiyeyya, vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya. yāvajīvaṃ rukkhamūlikā assu, yo channaṃ upagaccheyya, vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.9: yāvajīvaṃ macchamaṃsaṃ na khādeyyuṃ, yo macchamaṃsaṃ khādeyya, vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.11: yo icchati āraññiko hotu, yo icchati gāmante viharatu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.12: yo icchati piṇḍapātiko hotu, yo icchati nimantanaṃ sādiyatu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.13: yo icchati paṃsukūliko hotu, yo icchati gahapaticīvaraṃ sādiyatu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.14: aṭṭhamāse kho mayā devadatta, rukkhamūlasenāsanaṃ anuññātaṃ, tikoṭiparisuddhaṃ macchamaṃsaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.17: na bhagavā imāni pañca vatthūni anujānātīti haṭṭho udaggo sapariso uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.18: atha kho devadatto rājagahaṃ pavisitvā pañcahi vatthūhi janaṃ saññāpesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.19: “mayaṃ āvuso samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pañcavatthūni yācimha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.31: yo macchamaṃsaṃ khādeyya, vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.33: te mayaṃ imehi pañcahi vatthūhi samādāya vattāmā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.1: tattha ye te manussā assaddhā appasannā dubbuddhino, te evamāhaṃsu:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.3: samaṇo pana gotamo bāhuliko bāhullāya ceteti”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.4: ye pana te manussā saddhā pasannā paṇḍitā buddhimanto te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma devadatto bhagavato saṅghabhedāya parakkamissati cakkabhedāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma devadatto saṅghabhedāya parakkamissati cakkabhedāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.10: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ devadatta saṅghabhedāya parakkamasi cakkabhedāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.13: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa saṅghabhedāya parakkamissasi cakkabhedāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.16.1: “yo pana bhikkhu samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkameyya, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha tiṭṭheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.17: ‘mā āyasmā samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.18: sametāyasmā saṅghena. samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatī’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.19: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāva tatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.20: yāva tatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.8: ‘kathaṃ ime nānā assu vinā assu, vaggā assū’ti pakkhaṃ pariyesati, gaṇaṃ bandhati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.20: aññehi bhikkhūhi. ye passanti ye suṇanti tehi vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.21: “mā āyasmā samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.23: samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.30: “mā āyasmā samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.32: samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatī”ti.

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.43: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.46: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkamati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.48: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya,

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.56: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.59: samanubhaṭṭho saṅghena itthannāmo bhikkhu tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.65: saṅghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjantassa ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ, dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:3.1.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:3.1.2: dhammakamme vematiko na paṭinissajati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:3.1.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
